subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should session marks become a core structured session feature, or should OpenClaw expose a plugin presentation seam and keep preset marking outside core?
rationale: The branch adds a global slash command, hardcoded presets, localization policy, and persisted session state; code review cannot choose that permanent product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Use structured core mark state
options.body: Accept the capability in core only after preserving `label`, storing a dedicated mark identifier, and integrating normal localization and presentation paths.

options.title: Create a plugin presentation seam
options.body: Add the smallest supported API for plugins to decorate session presentation, then publish the preset workflow as a ClawHub plugin.

options.title: Decline preset marking
options.body: Keep session naming as the supported core mechanism and close the PR without adding another global command or persisted field.

recommendation.title: Use structured core mark state
recommendation.body: Accept the capability in core only after preserving `label`, storing a dedicated mark identifier, and integrating normal localization and presentation paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes core command scope, session-state semantics, and the plugin boundary defined by repository product policy.
